decision_basis: Two independent Docker canonical-build cycles produced the same zte_tpd.ko SHA-256.
Candidate and stock AArch64 assembly have identical 61 instructions, 244-byte symbol size and resolved relocations.
Both KCFI reports agree that no valid KCFI preamble is present; section, presence and size match exactly.
Strict Joern gate passed with zero parse problems and one-to-one source/Ghidra identity coverage.
The dedicated ASAN/UBSAN contract passed 5/5 cases in both reproducible cycles, covering normal, masked, denied, partial and forced-failure usercopy paths.
